# Meeting brief: Lotus Logistics

- Profile: Lotus Logistics — Logistics & warehousing, Hai Phong, Vietnam, about 1,200 staff, 9 warehouses. Lotus Logistics runs bonded warehouses and trucking between Hai Phong port and the northern industrial parks. It handles customs paperwork for about 300 importers.
- Email from Linh Tran: Exploring AI for our customs documents — Hello Northwind team, We are looking at AI to read customs declarations automatically. Could you tell us what you offer? Looking forward to our call on Wednesday. Linh Tran, COO, Lotus Logistics
- Contact: Linh Tran, Chief Operating Officer
- Contact: Bao Do, IT Manager
